thesis: The speakers argue that AI is not currently in a bubble because companies are deriving value from inference and have already paid off past development costs, though they acknowledge that future spending on larger models carries risk if those investments fail. They also present Epoch AI's forecast that AI will solve the Riemann hypothesis before it can reliably fold laundry, eliminate 10% of current jobs, and reach artificial general intelligence through surreal milestones rather than a sudden singularity.
